name: ActivityFeed
description: A vertical activity timeline whose events slide in one after another, each with a springy color-coded inline-SVG icon (commit, comment, deploy, merge, alert, star) and a connector line that draws down to the next event. Relative times are derived deterministically from minutes-ago values.
a11yNotes: A <section> labelled by its heading (visible or visually hidden) containing an ordered list, so screen readers announce the number of events. Icons and connector lines are aria-hidden decoration; each event is plain text and its relative time is a <time> element with an ISO 8601 duration in dateTime. Under prefers-reduced-motion all events appear immediately with no slide, spring or line draw.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.description: Events, newest first: { id, actor, action, target?, kind: 'commit' | 'comment' | 'deploy' | 'merge' | 'alert' | 'star', minutesAgo }.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Heading above the feed; also its accessible name.

propsApi.name: showTitle
propsApi.description: Show the heading visibly (otherwise visually hidden).

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay between events animating in, in milliseconds.

propsApi.name: showConnector
propsApi.description: Draw a vertical connector line between event icons.

propsApi.name: dense
propsApi.description: Compact spacing with smaller icons and inline times.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Commit icon color and connector tint.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
